notes: No manufacturer-published height/weight/DoF spec sheet for Figure 03 was located on figure.ai during this build (figure.ai/product returned HTTP 404); specs are left empty rather than filled from secondary blogs. Follow-up: check Figure's press kit or a dated product page once published.

Shipped bar applied (2026-09-20): BMW's own press portal (press.bmwgroup.com) published a 7-photo compilation on 2026-06-25 captioned "Humanoid robot Figure 03 at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg" -- a named customer (BMW Group Plant Spartanburg) with photographic evidence of the physical unit, published via the customer's own channel. Per this site's shipped rule, a named customer plus image via the customer's or an independent channel is sufficient; invoice/serial/unboxing/customs are alternatives, not an added requirement. Upgraded to shipped. (An earlier note in this file required invoice/serial/unboxing/customs in addition to the photo; that conjunctive reading was too strict and is removed.)
delivery.timeline[].sector set to automotive on all three events (2026-09-21): all are tied to the BMW Group Plant Spartanburg deployment.
